asset.name: DirtyStateGuard
asset.description: The navigation and dismissal guard detecting meaningful unsaved changes and offering save, discard, continue editing, or background preservation before the work is lost.

requires.reason: Values, validation, dirtiness, and submission live in the field-granular store rather than component state.

suggests.reason: The prompt needs a confirmation surface unless the host prefers to autosave silently.

rationale: Meaningful is the operative word: a guard that fires because a field was focused and blurred trains users to dismiss it, which is worse than having no guard.
